patch_list: Auto skip intro and recap
Automatically skips the intro, recap and song segments as soon as the 'Skip' button would appear, without waiting for a tap.
Auto-skip Up Next
Plays the next episode immediately when the "Up Next" card appears, skipping the auto-play countdown.
Change app name
Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.
Change package name

Changes the app package name so the patched app installs alongside the original. Set the desired package name in the patch options. Changing the package name can cause unexpected issues with some app features.
Disable AppsFlyer tracking
Disables AppsFlyer attribution and event tracking. Other SDKs (CleverTap, Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics) are not affected by this patch.
Disable Firebase tracking
Disables Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance data collection via manifest flags. Push notifications are unaffected.
Disable forced update
Removes the forced ('immediate') and optional ('flexi') 'update available' popup shown on the home screen.
Hide promo banners
Hides the CleverTap-driven subscribe/premium promo banners and promo trays on the home screen. Content rows and CleverTap pop-ups/overlays are not affected.
Remove video ads

Forces PlayerUtil.isAdEnable() to false so the player neither requests nor plays ads. Removes client-side (Google IMA) ads. Server-side stitched ads on some live content (MediaTailor/SSAI) may still appear.
Suppress geo / VPN block

Stops the dedicated "not available in your region" and "VPN detected" block screens by downgrading the geo/EPD block to a generic error. Geoblocking is enforced server-side by IP, so this does not grant access without a valid in-region IP…
